g.text: surveyed ground: see the basin sheet — CLUSTER 1 · THE MELTWASH BASIN

svg.text: Bellfaith survey where the towers see; mariners' report beyond
This is a compiled chart, not a single hand's survey. The basin ground is
the Bellfaith's own work, walked, sounded, and towered. Every coast beyond
it is set down from masters' logs sworn at Gildmark harbour, not from any
keel of ours. A hatched coast is reported, never vouched.
· the far interiors, past what any crew has walked
· whatever lies past the ice-cap's edge
the trade wind · once a year
